name: Ino (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ino town emblem in red: two interlocking rings.
history: Municipal flag of Ino, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2004.

features.role: Ino town emblem — two interlocking rings
